raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

The next DLFW container release will use Ubuntu 26.04 and Python 3.14. This PR should fix all compatibility issues with Python 3.14. From what I can tell, these issues are exclusively limited to the CI environment, as only newer pytest and pylint versions are required.

Changes are exclusively Python package upgrades or linter fixes for pylint v4.

Pytest changelog documenting 3.14 support: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html#pytest-8-4-0-2025-06-02
Pylint changelog documenting 3.14 support: https://pylint.readthedocs.io/en/latest/whatsnew/4/4.0/index.html

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

Please list the changes introduced in this PR:

- Updated TE to support Python 3.14 in CI environments

# Checklist:

- [ ] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [ ] The functionality is complete
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
